'''House Organa''' was the estate of the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] on the [[Apalis Coast]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. [[Castle Organa]] served as the heart of the estate.
